title: BaySimChip: R Shiny app and analysis code for 'Quantitative modeling of platform-specific processes to improve pharmacokinetic studies in organ-on-a-chip systems'
description: BaySimChip is an R Shiny app for compartmental pharmacokinetic models of organ-on-a-chip systems: build the model of a chip, define the experimental conditions (dosing, sampling, media exchange, evaporation, non-specific binding), simulate concentration-time profiles and estimate parameters such as intrinsic clearance and permeability from measured data. The repository also contains the R code, the processed concentration-time data and the results that reproduce the analyses and figures of the paper 'Quantitative modeling of platform-specific processes to improve pharmacokinetic studies in organ-on-a-chip systems' (submitted for publication). Code: GPL-3.0-or-later; data: CC BY 4.0.
